plain: Suffering death for one's faith, or suffering for a cause.

webster.text: The death of a martyr; the suffering of death on account of one's adherence to the faith of the gospel.

example.quote: that is, that our political creeds, which have been handed down to us by our forefathers as sacredly as our Bibles, and for which more of them have suffered martyrdom than for the creed of the apostles, are all nonsense ;
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, July 2, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
